nom: Good Molecules Rich Cream with Ceramides

avis.texte: Got really itchy bumps on my ears face and neck. Thought I could trust this brand but this product made me get a really bad reaction like others in the reviews.
Love this cream, great for hydration without being too heavy. I use Tret at night and this cream after and wake up with absolutely smooth skin.

avis.titre: My skin feels nourished and glows
avis.texte: I LOVE this moisturizer. It feels like a luxurious face cream without the hefty price tag. It leaves my skin supple and healthy-looking. It sinks in quick, but leaves a lovely glow. It may be heavy for some, but my sensitive and (sometimes dry) skin loves it!

I used this for a few days ( day and night ) and over the course of that time I broke out in tiny bumps all over my face! Mostly around my forehead, nose, and ear areas. At first I thought it was a new shampoo I tried once, but after seeing other reviews and photos of people who had the EXACT same issue I have, I realized that it was this product. I've stopped use and noticed immediate improvement. I do not typically have super sensitive skin, and I've never had an allergic reaction like this! EVER! I'm really bummed because at first I thought it was helping my skin and I loved the buttery texture. I also like a few other Good Molecules products. Needless to say I'm really sad about what has happened to my skin.

Love this for daily use. I put a small amount on following serum and let it soak in for 5 minutes or so before applying makeup. I love that it doesn't make my makeup pill like other moisturizers. Great for dry, thirsty skin!

avis.titre: I will buy this moisturizer again
avis.texte: I have combination skin, and needed an economic light weight moisturizer. This proved to be it. I use a pea size amount each time, does not leave my face oily or let it dry. I do wear sunscreen on top during the day, but at night it seems to help my skin and keep it hydrated.

The Good Molecules Rich Cream With Ceramides has been one of my favorite moisturizers! I love a moisturizer with ceramides and my skin enjoys it as well! I have combination skin and my t-zone tends to get oily during certain phases, however, I'm realizing that my skin likes hydration and this cream moisturizer does me very well without being overly shiny.

I dont usually put reviews out, but i wanted to warn people. I do not have sensitive skin, I am usually able to use whatever and be fine. This is the only new product I introduced into my routine because I was looking for a cheaper alternative, but after a few days of using this product, I started noticing a bunch of little bumps all over my face. After looking at some of these other reviews, I am sure this is what did it. I dont know what ingredient is making it do this, but beware.
I used this to help repair my skin barrier and by the second day I woke up and my eyes were swollen shut and I had red bumps all over my face. I had a very bad reaction! Wont suggest it or risk it.
I used it for about two days and got red bumps and blisters on my face, and also had a burning sensation. They eventually scabbed over. Would not use this again.

I use this as a moisturizer underneath my makeup. It serves as a long-lasting barrier all day long, indoors and outdoors. It makes me skin feel hydrated and plump and very critically, does not cause pilling with my makeup. Also this product is Yuka approved, and thst is a must have for me with skincare.

I'm 31 with skin that tends to be dry but is rarely sensitive. I know I should be cautious when introducing new skincare ingredients, but I wasn't with this: I used it all over on skin that was already feeling dryer than usual and it irritated my skin pretty badly. I didn't try it again until my ego had healed and my skin was starting from a good place. started with just the least sensitive areas and worked up to using it all over now. it has made my skin much happier at the end of a long winter day (when other moisturizers simply give up). also, the texture is very pleasant.
Its has zero smell, super creamy and rich. It calms my redness down alot

avis.titre: DO NOT USE THIS - ALLERGIC REACTIONS
avis.texte: This caused horrible, itchy bumps all over my face. This is not uncommon with this product. Very annoying to deal with - stay far away!

avis.titre: This Saved My Skin from the Chicago Weather
avis.texte: The Rich Cream with Ceramides works wonderfully on my face. I'm 64 and the moisturizing effect is perfect. I feel so protected. The skin barrier is real. I am very satisfied with the feel and light smell. A great find. Love it!

avis.titre: If your skin is sensitive, don't use it
avis.texte: I used this moisturizer and I immediately had a ton of itchy little bumps all over my face where I used it. The lightweight daily moisturizer is much better and gentler for people with sensitive skin.

I love this moisturizer! I needed a new one as my skin has been SO dry recently. This moisturizer is rich and hydrating which is exactly what my skin needed. This probably isn't for oily skin types but it is perfect for dry skin.

Genuinely one of the best moisturizers I have put on my sensitive acne prone skin! This might just be my forever moisturizer. My skin feels incredibly firm, plump, and hydrated. If you want to feel pretty in your own skin, get yourself a bottle!

tried this because so far ive loved the brand and needed a new moisturizer. First, i know it says its rich, but its lowkey and understatement lol. This cream is very very thick to me, little goes a long way but at the same time it almost feels uncomfortable to not cake on? if its too thin its not as spreadable. But if you put too much ive noticed it start to crumble and almost like pilling on my face and i have to rub it off my face so i dont have white crumbs on my face, looking dirty. Second, I have pretty oily skin and know thicker creams arent the best but again love the brand so far so said f it why not, but this is really not for oily skin as it only enhances it. and if youre putting this on in a hot bathroom, god bless.

I could be allergic to some of ingredients in this product, that I was unaware of so look into the ingredients! That being said, this prduct broke me out. I had tiny red bumps along my jawline, cheek area, and well into my upper neck. This was noticeable within the next two days I first used the product. I stopped using it immediately. Otherwise, I'm usually really satisfied with Good Molecules.
Absolutely love Good Molecules but especially this one! It makes my face feel hydrated and smooth while giving it all the love it needs. You can't go wrong with it! Especially in the winter. ✨️
It was hydrating but the stickiness was just too much for me 🥴 if you have dry skin and dont mind that, you might enjoy this..

avis.titre: Listen to the other reviews about red bumps!
avis.texte: I didnt read the reviews and purchased based on the ingredients and a recommendation from the skin sort app. I have itchy dry red bumps all over my face! I thought maybe I had overdone it with the good molecules retinol but after reading the reviews it's was definitely this. Whoops, live and ya learn.

I have consistently used Good Molecules products for years and they are usually amazing for my skin. This made me feel confident that I could ignore the negative reviews and give this a chance. Wrong! I used it for the first time earlier this week, and after the second use, I woke up to find my forehead and neck completely covered in tiny bumps. Four days later, they are fading but now I have itchy, flaky, dry spots where the bumps were. I do have acne-prone skin, but this type of reaction has never happened to me with any product in my life. Please don't buy this!

I love good molecules skincare line & was so excited to add this into my winter skincare line up for added hydration however my face broke out in tiny little bumps EVERYWHERE. They burn, they itch, they're red & raised. I do not have sensitive skin but whatever is in here is not it. Prior to not knowing what this reaction was from, once my face was settling from what i thought was hives, i was left with dry flaky patches & i thought ill just use this to help and BAM immediately came back.

I have very sensitive skin but had no issues with this product. I do not doubt others may have but it works great for me. I always do a test spot and had no reaction. Usually if i do react it is not the product itself but it is a combination of products. Some peole may be sensitive to the ceramides; it might help to use it only a few times per week vs every day (I have to be very careful with Vitamin C products that other people have no issue using). I would def recommend but would advise to try a test area prior to using all over.
I have been using this moistuizer for about a month. I enjoy its thick texture and is hydrating during time of application. I feel it does not have good longevity and peels through out the day.

Like others here have said, I also broke out in tiny bumps all over my face. They weren't red but my skin felt like it burned so bad. It caused texture and now its just incredibly dry and flaky. I only used it three times. My skin is still tender and sensitive and its been almost a week since I last used it. I have no idea what ingredient in here caused it to happen but I wont be using this again. I really had high hopes for it because I love their yerba mate eye gel. Probably wont be trying any new stuff from them for a while. Really hoping it doesnt take forever for my skin to heal.

A lot of people are saying that they broke out in tiny bumps...that happens to me every now and then but that did NOT happen with this one. I wanted a thick moisturizer for a decent price and this is it! Will def repurchase.

I've always had dry/combo skin and have a damaged skin barrier. I live in Utah where the cold and dry weather can be SO HARSH. This product I've been able to continuously use and it takes the redness away, leaves my skin feeling hydrated, looking plump and even gives me a little bit of a glow! I'm always getting compliments from other girls! :) Would def reccomend to other girls and guys who struggle with those things as well. I feel like because it's helped repair my skin barrier it has also helped tone down the acne, inflammation and redness that comes with it!

I had used this product for two days, and woke up with tiny bumps all over my chin by the third day. I was so happy about the product because it eas so hydrating, but now I have soo much texture on my skin!! I typically am careful about what moisturizer i use, however i felt this one was going to work. Disappointed :(

I didn't want to believe the reviews of our breaking out but same situation happened to me. The first day was fine with the second day broke on a rash everywhere and have to go to a wedding in two days. I'm so scared.

Truthfully I'm always scared to try something new but this moisturizer does help my skin, I have combination acne prone skin with closed comedones - the ceramides moisturizer supports my skin in added hydration so yes I am surprised.

I find this product to actually help rid my eczema- for years doctors recommended CeraVe, Eucerin, Burts Bees, and various drug store eczema creams that worsened my eczema and often gave me burning sensations on my eczema patches. It also tested to be 100/100 rating when using a food and cosmetics scanning app- meaning its all good ingredients and not carcinogenic- which is often rare!!

This cream finally helped with my super dry skin above my lip. It was peeling and awful. I tried all sort of things including Neosporin. With this cream, my whole face feels like it's actually moisturized.

Within a day of using this, tiny bumps literally covered my face. The bumps then dried out and now are itchy and flakey. I'm so bummed because I LOVE good molecules. I started a couple new good molecules products at the same time and thought my skin was reacting to a different product (the sakura hyaluronic acid boosting essence) but I stopped using it and continued using the rich cream to try to heal the dry and flakey bumps, but it only got worse. It wasn't until I looked up reviews for the rich cream that I realized it was the culprit. Back to my old moisturizer I suppose!
I have really bad dry patches in the winter and this helped *a ton*. I used it at night with the GM lightweight moisturizer during the day. 10/10
I love all of my good molecules products that i have, so i was so disappointed when this broke me out terribly. Very red rash and breakouts everywhere.
my skin has been extra dry but this made it worse. I used this one time and then broke out in a bumpy rash. it took almost a week to fully go away.

After a couple days of use I developed a itchy rash on my face. I love good molecules, but wouldnt risk it with this specific product after seeing that others have had the same issue. It does have a nice consistency and feels nice upon applying and I would love to see a similar product doesnt cause irritation.

This is my new staple. It's thick in texture but not heavy, it absorbs so beautifully and leaves my face feeling nourished. Its not greasy or tacky which I have a REALLY hard time nailing in a moisturizer for my oily skin. Most products are instantly grease on my face. This just feels like my skin. 10/10 new favourite.

I bought this and after just 2 uses I woke up the next morning if a rash type situation. Hundreds of tiny bumps everywhere i applied the cream…they got worse throughout the day and were itchy! I haven't used this product in 2 days and the bumps and itchiness are still there. I got this hoping it would help perfect my skin care routine, but it has managed to derail ans set me back. Ive very diligent about my skin care and usually LOVE Good Molecules, but this was a huge miss. Maybe it needs to be reformulated since it just released a few months ago. In addition to the bumps and itching, it also made the skin under my eyes swell up so much (usually my undereyes are slightly sunken, and ove never had bags or puffiness under them). I'm so disappointed and am hoping i can return the product for a refund or store credit because I will absolutely never touch this again. Save yourself money, your skin, and a headahce by not getting this. The lightweight moisturizer is wonderful, or CereVe Moisturizing Cream for something thicker and more hydrating.

I just bought this moisturizer last month because my face was starting to get dry. It's very moisturizing. Just what I was looking for. I have combination skin. I haven't experienced any breakouts. I also had my husband try as well and had to get him his own.

Seriously, one of my favorite new products. I've been using this, plus the Azelaic Acid Treatment and Azelaic Acid Wash, for the last month. My skin has felt less inflamed, hydrated, and protected. This moisturizer goes on really well under the sunscreen and makeup, but I also like it with just the sunscreen without makeup because it gives just enough glow without being shiny. This was the moisturizer I was looking for; it has fully transformed my skin. Only complaint is that it's in a small size, I need it in a bigger container.
I wish I would've seen the other reviews regarding this moisturizer before using it. I had the same terrible reaction of textured bumps all over my face.

avis.titre: Finally a replacement for the ceramedx ceramide cream
avis.texte: Its a bit heavier compared to ceramedx but it accomplishes the same thing. I have dry sensitive acne prone skin and I use this every night around my eyes, your undereye concealer will sit better in the morning. Leaves a glowy finish like you slugged but without feeling greasy and staining everything. Will be repurchasing

I received this in a bundle I ordered and I liked it so much I bought a full size. I have dry, sensitive skin and haven't had any issues. I didn't notice a scent or have a reaction. It's moisturizing without making you look oily, it works really well with my makeup. I recommend!

I'm not being dramatic when I say this moisturizer changed my skin in the best way. My skin is extremely acne prone and I rosacea. Seriously 90% of skincare products break me out. I've been using this mousturizer for over a month and have not had ANY new breakouts. My skin is soft and even toned. The redness is under control. I hope this never goes away and that they make a bigger bottle.

I really wanted to love this product but i had the eorst reaction. like others have said, terrible little bumps all over my face. painful, itchg, and took days to get rid of. its not worth the risk to try!!

I'm seeing some people had bad reactions but I had the exact opposite results! This stuff is awesome for my oily and acne prone skin. It doesn't break me out at all and my skin is so smooth and my pores look smaller. Please never stop making this!

I have rosacea, oily, and extremely acne prone skin. I break out so easily from products. This moisturizer has my skin calm, balanced, and completely clear. I haven't had a rosacea flare or new pimple in over a month. I'm so grateful for this product!
Its thick, creamy and you can see the moisture hours later without looking oily

I do not have acne prone skin and have loved other products by good molecules. I used this maybe 3 days and noticed my entire forehead was covered in tiny bumps! I've never had a product give me so much texture and at first I thought I was having an allergic reaction. Nope, just very comedogenic
I llve this product I needed a new face lotion that would help my dry skin while using trentoin and its been really helpful

I was anticipating this moisturizer forever and i love good molecules so i was heartbroken when i used this (only TWICE) and found my forehead absolutely covered in tiny bumps, like every inch. I literally even took allergy medicine to see if i was allergic to something, but it wasnt that. They didnt itch and they mostly werent yet red, it was literally just more texture on my forehead than i have ever experienced in my life. Sooo sad, had exfoliate for days to make them go away. Had to return :(

I was skeptical of this product at first vecause I have oily skin and was worried it would be too heavy. But I'm actually suprised how hydrating this product is for my skin that it laid down perfect and it actually helped my skin be less oily compared to the Daily Moisturizer.

My skin had a bad reaction to the cream. I've never been allergic to anything before so imagine my surprise when I look in the mirror and my face is swollen. The swelling has went down, but my skin feels extremely dry around my eyes.
I have been using this product consistently for about a month. It has been essential for me to combat the fall dryness and hasn't caused any issues. Skin is looking and feeling great!

I absolutely love this product. It is the perfect moisturizer. Leave my skin supple and glowy. Doesn't clog pores. It is also made with clean ingredients. I will use this forever! I only wish it came in a larger size, I would prefer a bigger tube to buying duos or trios of the smaller one.

I am really sensitive and acne prone, and this didn't irritate me at all! My skin actually feels really soft the next morning after using this. The only thing I will say is that (to me) it has kind of a weird scent. Not fragrance or anything but kind of waxy like a crayon lol. Its not terrible but it is noticeable.
extra rich cream for the dry climate. exquisite under liquid or cream foundations and on just a bare face. will def buy again.

was genuinely so surprised, love many of good molecules products and have used many others in my life and never thought myself to have sensitive skin. used it for two days and my skin was bumpy all over and started showing signs of acne growth and swelling.

avis.titre: Great winter moisturizer for oily skin!
avis.texte: 9.5/10 amazingggg It takes a few minutes to soak in but love it!!
Finally a good moisturizer that doesn't irritate sensitive and reactive skin!
i really wanted to love this product as alternative to the cocokind peptide cream but it was awful. broke me out on my forehead and chest so badly and left me so oily. don't try 🙏
Excellent product. Very rich & thick. Im mature skin. Im thinking very rich for oily skin. Wish it was larger but still excellent price point

avis.titre: My Skin Feels Soft and Healthy Again
avis.texte: The Good Molecules Rich Cream with Ceramides is a great moisturizer that makes my skin feel soft and smooth. It's rich but not heavy, and it soaks in quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. My skin feels calm, hydrated, and healthy after using it. It reminds me of the Embryolisse cream I liked, but this one feels a bit more moisturizing and comforting.
This gives just the right amount of moisture and soothing to my mature sensitive skin. I'll definitely repurchase!

avis.titre: Good Molecules: Rich Cream with Ceramides
avis.texte: I think it's a good skincare item and cream for dryness especially but there's a little smell to it that is a little bothersome. I still use and enjoy the cream very much, as it's good for the skin, but wouldn't rank it my #1 favorite good molecules product
BUY THIS PRODUCT! It's seriously amazing and it has become a part of my every day routine.

This cream is very smooth and rich. When I apply this cream it is thick and rich cream but very lightweight when you apply. After applying this product it is very hydrating and repairing to the skin. My face stayed hydrated all throughout the day in the summer heat and the cooling night. I've also noticed a smooth and hydrated barrier to my skin. Gifted by Good Molecules

Good Molecules have not let me down yet and now after having the privilege of using the new Rich Cream with Ceramides moisturizer is exactly what I needed. It is rich and creamy just as it says and I can just feel the moisture in my skin while making it feel soft and smooth. I use it along with the Hyaluronic Serums after cleansing for my morning and night regimen. My face looks so glowy and it's even better now that their products are available at Ulta Beauty and I don't have to wait and order it online anymore. Thank you. Gifted by Good Molecules

First, you need to know that I received an advanced product to try before the release. I am a repeat buyer of several different Good Molecules products. The opinions are completely my own. A esthetician recently told me that I needed to add a soothing moisturizer with ceramides, so I was excited to give this a try. It soothed the dry patches on my cheeks after one use! I absolutely love this moisturizer! It is rich and creamy, as the name indicates. It didn't clog my pores or cause breakouts. It goes on smooth, soaks in, and absorbs with a slight sheen. I had no issues wearing it under makeup either. If you need some hydration, this is definitely the product to try!

I've been using this product for about a week now and I'd honestly have to say that this product has made my skin softer and also has eliminated pores from being seen. I started using this as soon as I got it I smell it. It doesn't have a strong scent, but it is really good it's creamy it's lightweight. It doesn't make your skin oily. I work in the sun and it doesn't do that. I apply it at night time before I go to bed and when I wake up, I have a nice soft glowing. Look to my skin. I have used it before going out on occasion and it's done wonders. I've used it as moisturizer before applying my make up and it's had good progress. There is no scent to the product. Face feels hydrated after using it. Gifted by Good Molecules

I have dry skin and I live in a very dry area so I'm always looking for a moisturizer that I only need to apply once. I like how thick and creamy the formula is. It makes my skin feel soft and protected. The only thing I'm not a huge fan of is it makes me feel oily mid way through the day. Gifted by Good Molecules

This moisturizer is very soft when applied to my skin. It feels hydrating at first however an hour later my skin felt dry again. I have very dry acne prone skin so moistures are tricky for me to find that don't break me out. This one didn't seem to help my acne or make it worse. Gifted by good molecules.

The Rich Cream with Ceramides is a dream moisturizer for those of us with dry skin. I live in a dry climate, and it feels like I have to choose between keeping moisture in my skin or a moisturizer that works well under makeup: this cream gives you the best of both worlds. My skin felt so soft and comfortable all day and I never felt greasy even with makeup on top. This might be heavy for those in humid places during the summer, but here in the desert, it's perfect year-round. Gifted by Good Molecules for my honest review.

The Good Molecules Rich Cream is luxuriously smooth, absorbing quickly without greasiness. It delivers lasting hydration, leaving my skin plump, soft, and radiant all day. Even in humid weather, it feels light yet deeply nourishing. My skin's texture has improved noticeably, and it now looks healthier and more refreshed. Gifted by Good Molecules

GM has delivered! I have aging skin in a dry climate and need max moisturizing. I love the lightweight moisturizer since it does not trigger any sensitivities, but I have to apply it several times a day. This is the answer I have been seeking. It is rich and creamy; it absorbs quickly with no residue sticking on the skin. My face feels so smooth and clean and supply immediately, and it lasts all day. And as with the lightweight moisturizer, no negative reactions. My skin has been improving so satisfactorily with GM products over the past few years, and this is the final piece of the puzzle. I love it! Gifted by Good Molecules
